B_access_pricing.mcp_access_cost_details: B12 says connecting to its MCP server does not cost anything and an existing B12 account is not required to connect and generate a site.
B_access_pricing.linked_software_cost: B12 lists a Free subscription; Website at $24/month billed monthly or $20/month billed annually; Website + Client Engagement at $78/month or $67/month annually. Prices and plans may change.
B_access_pricing.pricing_model_details: The Free subscription includes 5 AI credits per day, up to 30 per month. Paid plans list monthly AI credit allocations. The MCP article does not specify whether MCP-generated sites consume credits.
B_access_pricing.other_access_restrictions: Client-side connection restrictions may apply. B12 notes that Claude Team or Enterprise requires an Owner to add the connector organization-wide, and free Claude accounts can have only one custom connector at a time.
B_access_pricing.restrictions_controlled_by: B12 controls MCP access; AI client and organization administrators control client connector availability.

D_server_side_logic.additional_logic: 1. One website-generation tool is listed; it creates a site, so it is a write action. B12's hosted docs do not expose its annotations. Manufact reports readOnlyHint=false and destructiveHint=false; idempotentHint is not shown there. 2. No server-enforced confirmation step documented. B12 says the returned link lets the user preview, refine, and publish; publishing is described as a later user action. 3. B12 says no existing account is required. OAuth metadata probes returned 404; role inheritance, token lifetime/revocation, and allowlists are undocumented. 4. Only one hosted URL is documented. No read-only mode, tool filtering, environment separation, or regional variants found. 5. No MCP-specific data masking or scope boundaries documented. Privacy policy says AI prompt data is not used to train generalized AI/ML models, and prompt data is retained up to 30 days except Fal.ai data, retained until deleted by B12. 6. No MCP-specific limits, quotas, truncation, or per-call cost documented. Product plans list AI-credit limits; whether MCP use consumes credits is unspecified. 7. Hosted input validation/correction behavior is undocumented. Manufact reports four required string inputs but is a third party. 8. MCP logging/audit behavior is undocumented. Privacy policy describes general service safeguards and subprocessors, including cloud hosting and AI/LLM processing. 9. No feedback, rating, survey, or report tool found in the one-tool list. Tool leads users to claim/edit a website on B12; no explicit upsell text established from official docs. 10. Official B12 plugins repository includes separate agent skills outside the server, but their application to this endpoint is not established. 11. No evidence that past agent behavior changes tools or outputs. 12. One flat website-generator tool is documented. 13. No raw API, SQL, script, or general-purpose escape-hatch tool found.

E_aggregated.human_can_agent_cannot: A user can preview, refine, and publish the generated site after opening the returned link. F_documentation.implementation_hints_not_enforced: The B12 help article advises clients to verify the URL, enable the connector for the conversation, check organization-level setup, and restart/reconnect when troubleshooting. These are client-side setup instructions, not server-enforced rules.
F_documentation.governance_promises: B12's privacy policy states that AI prompt data is not used to train generalized AI/ML models; prompt data is retained for up to 30 days, except Fal.ai, which retains data until deleted by B12. B12 describes safeguards including TLS in transit, production database encryption at rest, and restricted access.
F_documentation.promises_to_user: B12 says the server is hosted, requires no installation, can generate an editable website, and returns a link for preview, refinement, and publication. It says connection to the MCP server is free and no existing B12 account is required.
F_documentation.comparison_with_server_logic: The website generation and returned-link behavior is documented, but the hosted server implementation is not public. The privacy policy's AI-data and security commitments apply to B12 services generally; no MCP-specific enforcement or audit behavior is documented. Publishing is described as a user action after opening the returned link.

contradictions: The hosted endpoint tool schema reported by Manufact has four required inputs (name, description, image_keywords, subtitle), while Glama's code-backed local repository reference shows two required inputs (name, description). B12 describes the local server as a separate open-source version; the difference may reflect hosted/local variants.
Manufact reports a static preview image and link, while B12's help article describes a link to preview, refine, and publish the site but does not mention an image.
observations_for_research: The hosted tool's reported required inputs include image search keywords and a hero subtitle, while the local repository's schema reported by Glama requires only business name and description.
The result directs the user to B12's hosted editor for preview, refinement, and publishing; the documented MCP interaction itself is limited to generation and link return.
notes: Reviewed links.json, links_check.txt, pages/ and the available local code copies. The official website-generator repository was listed but not present as a local checkout; its collected GitHub pages identify a local stdio server and manifest.
